Bark Break: day outing (neighborhood walk, Cameron Park, or home). Pick a dog, fill out a form at the front desk and show valid ID. Sleepover Rover: overnight or weekend check-out, also works as a no-commitment adoption trial. Adoption center hours Mon-Fri noon-6pm, Sat 10am-5pm, Sun 1-5pm.
